name: status-conversions
of: A mechanism by which one form of standing converts into another, named with the conversion, its carrier, the shape of the exchange rate (where it is generous, where it is refused), and the place where the same conversion is treated as fraud; sorted by who must write the new entry, from conversions nobody has to write to conversions that the holder's own spending erases.
items: Unrefusable glance: beauty converts into audience through attention the audience does not choose to pay, as the pretty busker draws the crowd the better player did not, and nobody has to decide anything for the conversion to run; the rate is highest at first sight and falls with exposure, and the same beauty converts into credit at a discount, because attention that was not chosen is not read as anyone's judgment.

Furniture's ear: access converts into information in proportion to how little standing the person present has, as valets, drivers, interpreters, and the junior aide hear what the visiting minister is performed for; high standing buys the stage and low standing buys the wings, and the conversion is refused to whoever the room notices, so the rate falls the moment one is promoted.

Collar on loan: office converts into deference on sight, but the standing belongs to the office and is lent to the body inside it, as the uniform, the collar, and the robe convert with strangers and not with the congregation that knows the man; refused conversion into personal standing, since it stays with the collar when he takes it off, and impersonating an officer is the fraud of borrowing without the loan.

Familiarity as vetting: fame converts into credit because a recognized name is processed as a prior acquaintance, as the actor is trusted with a policy and the television doctor with a supplement; generous in every domain the audience does not itself practice, and refused inside the guild, whose members meet the same name as a stranger's, so the rate is set by the audience's ignorance rather than by the fame.

Witnessed save: competence converts into deference through a moment with stakes that others saw, as the night nurse who caught the tenfold dose is deferred to by physicians for years afterward; a credential claims the same competence without the witness and converts at a fraction, so the rate is set by the stakes and the audience present, not by the skill, and the competent who were never in the room hold an unconverted balance.

Scar tariff: sacrifice converts into authority in proportion to what cannot be recovered, as the veteran, the striker who lost the house, and the founder who ate the lean years are heard before the unscarred; compensated sacrifice converts at almost nothing, since a paid martyr is an employee, and stolen valor is the fraud of claiming the authority without having paid the tariff.

Injury as license: grievance converts into standing through the injured party's right to speak first and to be answered, as the bereaved mother addresses the legislature and the wronged employee is given the floor; refused once compensation is accepted, because the payment closes the account, and refused again when the injury was manufactured or bought, while whether it may be inherited past living memory is contested and this map leaves it so.

Practice given to the trusted: standing converts back into competence, the reverse of the witnessed save, because whoever is already deferred to is handed the hard cases and becomes what he was presumed, as the resident the chief likes is given the interesting surgeries; the rate is generous and the product is indistinguishable afterward from competence that earned its own presumption, which is the discount nobody can collect.

Introducer's tab: credit converts into access through a third party who spends his own standing to open the door, as the referee, the letter-writer, and the friend who says take the meeting; the rate is charged to the introducer and not to the introduced, which is why a paid introduction converts at nothing and the referee with a fee is the fraud. Adds to the exchange-ontologies item Vouching the shape of the rate: the converter pays, so credit moves only as fast as someone will be billed for it.

Gift that keeps no hand: money converts into respect only by being given away, with the rate set by how completely the giver lets go, as the hospital wing carries the donor's name but not the donor's vote on who is treated; refused, and re-read as a purchase, the moment the donor wants the microphone, so the same dollars buy respect or buy contempt depending only on whether a hand stays on them.

Cashing out: standing converts into money through the endorsement, the paid speech, the board seat, and the memoir, at a generous rate that consumes the stock, as the retired general and the musician who sells the jingle each spend some of what they sell; the reverse conversion must pass through the gift, so the round trip from money to respect to money leaks in both directions, and the undisclosed endorsement is the fraud of cashing standing while still presenting it as uncashed.

Notarized standing: a credential is a bearer copy of an entry held in someone else's ledger, which is what lets conferred standing cross a border or a decade at all, as the ship's master's ticket converts into command on any deck that honors the issuing authority; converts only between registries that recognize each other, and the diploma mill is the fraud of printing the copy with no entry behind it.

Standing left at the border: conferred standing is a balance in the conferrers' ledger and not in the holder, so it does not travel with the body, as the Damascus surgeon who drives a taxi in Berlin is exactly as skilled and has lost all deference; the conversion fails by venue rather than by rate, and the local registry prices re-entry as if from zero, because it never wrote the entry it is being asked to honor.

Staleness discount: an entry in the registry expires unless it is re-witnessed, so the carpenter six years out of work loses credit at a rate set by the length of the gap and not by any change in the hands; the refusal here is temporal where the border's is spatial, a document repairs one and only a fresh shift repairs the other, and the padded résumé is the fraud of inventing witnesses for the missing years.

Immunity by entanglement: seniority converts into immunity as the institution's memory and other people's careers come to run through one person, so that removal costs more than tolerance, as the thirty-year clerk and the surgeon who trained every attending are forgiven what a newcomer would be fired for; refused the day a successor is trained, which is why the hoarder who keeps the only keys is the fraud form of the same mechanism.

Time as the only tender: belonging is conferred by insiders in a currency that cannot be accelerated, as the newly rich are admitted a generation later, the parish accepts the incomer's children, and prison seniority is counted in years actually served; the rate is fixed at one year per year and no sum buys a second year inside the same year, so the forged pedigree is the fraud and patience is not a virtue here but the price.

Refusal premium: authority is conferred on those seen not to want it, as the monastery elects the monk who hid from the vote and the meeting names as clerk the member who declined twice; the conversion is open only to those who do not perform it, so reluctance on camera is the fraud, and the premium is refused precisely to whoever asks for it, which makes it the one conversion an operator cannot run on purpose.

Evidence that spending erases: conferred standing is valuable as evidence of someone else's judgment, so buying it destroys what was bought, as the purchased title, the self-financed candidate, and the bought followers each announce that no one else would have conferred them; the one-way rule of the map, that whatever standing functions as another party's verdict cannot be converted into by money, only by a verdict-giver who is not the holder and gains nothing from him.

source.register: Concrete and mechanistic, for someone who must move in a status order they did not design: nurses, valets, monks, veterans, donors, immigrant surgeons, the long-term unemployed, the newly rich, ships' masters, prisoners; no self-help vocabulary, no exchange rate given a number.
source.mode: Separated mixture: the mechanisms are analytical, the illustrative cases are observed and simplified to one mechanism each, and one item (Injury as license) carries a contested boundary and says so; no item is invented-world and no rate is claimed as measured.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork in a separated mixture of registers: the mechanisms are analytical and the cases are observed and simplified to one mechanism each; no exchange rate is measured, and none is claimed to hold across cultures or periods.
The seriation is an itinerary by who must write the entry, not a ranking of legitimacy, of yield, or of how much any conversion is worth; the edges are conditional authored claims.

Bearer standing and registry standing are an authored distinction, not a claim that any standing is purely one or the other; competence is bearer-form in the hands and registry-form in the reputation, and several items live on the seam.

Conversions called fraud here are those the communities involved refuse; the map does not judge whether each refusal is just, and the inheritance of grievance standing in particular is left contested inside its own item.

Coercion (standing extracted by threat) and inheritance (standing passed by birth) are outside the list except where they appear as fraud cases or as time-denominated admission; whether fear can be laundered into honor is held as a seed.

seriation.axis: Who must write the new entry for the conversion to hold: from conversions nobody writes (the eye converts beauty into audience on its own, presence converts into hearing), through conversions that need a witness at a moment, then a witness who pays, then a registry that must recognize or wait, to conversions that only a party other than the holder can make and that the holder's own spending erases.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of legitimacy or of yield. Unrefusable glance opens it because no one has to decide anything for the conversion to run; Evidence that spending erases closes it because nothing the holder can do writes the entry. The hinge is Gift that keeps no hand followed by Cashing out: the same person crosses the seam between bearer standing (money, beauty, hands) and registry standing (respect, credit, title) in both directions, and the pair shows that giving converts money into respect only by letting go while cashing out converts respect into money only by spending it, so the round trip returns less in both currencies and money-to-standing-to-money is not an arbitrage. A second adjacency, Notarized standing followed by Standing left at the border, teaches that the credential is the device built for exactly the failure the border names, and that the failure is one of recognition between registries rather than of the person. Practice given to the trusted sits after Injury as license as the first conversion that runs backward across the seam, turning a registry entry into hands.

relations.from: Witnessed save: competence converts into deference through a moment with stakes that others saw, as the night nurse who caught the tenfold dose is deferred to by physicians for years afterward; a credential claims the same competence without the witness and converts at a fraction, so the rate is set by the stakes and the audience present, not by the skill, and the competent who were never in the room hold an unconverted balance.

relations.label: If deference earned at one witnessed save is spent as the allocation of the next hard cases, the deferred-to accumulate competence that others were never handed, so the loop closes and an outsider can no longer tell earned from presumed; the newcomer's entry problem is that the first save requires a case, and cases go to those who have already saved.

relations.label: If the interpreter or the aide performs a witnessed save, the room begins to notice him and the unguarded speech stops; the two conversions cannot be held by one body in one room, so whoever wants to be heard must give up hearing, and the ear is kept only by staying unconverted.

relations.label: If the sacrifice is later cashed, as the memoir, the paid speech, or the settlement, the tariff is refunded and the authority drains at the rate the money arrives; the veteran who monetizes the wound is re-read as having been paid all along, so the scar forks at compensation into authority or salary and cannot hold both.

relations.label: If the donor keeps any hand on the gift, the same transfer is reclassified from conferral to purchase, and purchase of conferred standing erases the evidence the standing would have been; so the donor who wants the microphone converts money not into less respect but into its opposite, since the wing now shows that the standing had to be bought.

relations.from: Notarized standing: a credential is a bearer copy of an entry held in someone else's ledger, which is what lets conferred standing cross a border or a decade at all, as the ship's master's ticket converts into command on any deck that honors the issuing authority; converts only between registries that recognize each other, and the diploma mill is the fraud of printing the copy with no entry behind it.

relations.label: If the receiving registry recognizes the issuing one, the credential carries the entry across and the border does not fire; if it does not, the credential is paper and the surgeon drives the taxi, so the border is a failure of recognition between registries, and only a treaty between them, never any act of the holder, repairs it.

relations.from: Time as the only tender: belonging is conferred by insiders in a currency that cannot be accelerated, as the newly rich are admitted a generation later, the parish accepts the incomer's children, and prison seniority is counted in years actually served; the rate is fixed at one year per year and no sum buys a second year inside the same year, so the forged pedigree is the fraud and patience is not a virtue here but the price.

relations.label: If time is the only tender a registry accepts, it is also the only solvent it uses: the same clock that admits the incomer's children expires the carpenter's credit, so a registry that prices in years both confers and forgets at a fixed rate, and its conversions are one-way because the clock does not run backward.

relations.from: Injury as license: grievance converts into standing through the injured party's right to speak first and to be answered, as the bereaved mother addresses the legislature and the wronged employee is given the floor; refused once compensation is accepted, because the payment closes the account, and refused again when the injury was manufactured or bought, while whether it may be inherited past living memory is contested and this map leaves it so.
relations.to: Evidence that spending erases: conferred standing is valuable as evidence of someone else's judgment, so buying it destroys what was bought, as the purchased title, the self-financed candidate, and the bought followers each announce that no one else would have conferred them; the one-way rule of the map, that whatever standing functions as another party's verdict cannot be converted into by money, only by a verdict-giver who is not the holder and gains nothing from him.
relations.label: If the grievance is compensated, the license is spent; if it was bought or manufactured, the standing is erased retroactively, since a purchased injury evidences no wrong done; the one-way rule applies even to the one standing nobody wants conferred, which is why the professional victim is refused by the same mechanism as the purchased peer.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does one form of standing convert into another (money into respect, competence into deference, sacrifice into authority, fame into credit), and at what point is each conversion refused or treated as fraud?
exploration.changed_question: Where is the standing stored, and who must write the entry? The first breath treated standings as currencies with exchange rates. Laying the refusals side by side (the bought title, the donor with the microphone, the surgeon in the taxi) showed that conferred standing is a balance in other people's ledgers, not in the holder, so a conversion into it needs a writer who is not the holder, and the exchange-rate picture gave way to a distinction between bearer standing that travels with the body and registry standing that does not.
exploration.new_member: Standing left at the border: conferred standing is a balance in the conferrers' ledger and not in the holder, so it does not travel with the body, as the Damascus surgeon who drives a taxi in Berlin is exactly as skilled and has lost all deference; the conversion fails by venue rather than by rate, and the local registry prices re-entry as if from zero, because it never wrote the entry it is being asked to honor.

priorities.item: Introducer's tab: credit converts into access through a third party who spends his own standing to open the door, as the referee, the letter-writer, and the friend who says take the meeting; the rate is charged to the introducer and not to the introduced, which is why a paid introduction converts at nothing and the referee with a fee is the fraud. Adds to the exchange-ontologies item Vouching the shape of the rate: the converter pays, so credit moves only as fast as someone will be billed for it.
priorities.why: It is the one conversion whose rate is charged to a third party, so its shape can be checked from ordinary records without measuring anyone's standing; if it holds, it explains why paid introduction markets keep failing and where an operator with little credit can still borrow some.
priorities.next_question: For one month, log every introduction made or received with two fields: what the introducer stood to lose if it went badly, and whether the door actually opened; sort by the first field alone and see whether it predicts the second better than anything about the person introduced.

priorities.item: Refusal premium: authority is conferred on those seen not to want it, as the monastery elects the monk who hid from the vote and the meeting names as clerk the member who declined twice; the conversion is open only to those who do not perform it, so reluctance on camera is the fraud, and the premium is refused precisely to whoever asks for it, which makes it the one conversion an operator cannot run on purpose.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that it survives being known, high generative promise: it is the one conversion an operator cannot run on purpose, and any body that relies on it must have a way of telling real reluctance from performed reluctance, which nobody has written down.
priorities.next_question: Take three bodies that fill offices by visible non-seeking (a monastic election, a Quaker clerkship, a volunteer fire company) and find the actual rule or tell each uses to disqualify the campaigner; then ask whether the tell is a cost the seeker will not pay, which would fold this item into Scar tariff, or a different mechanism.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference

neighbors.left: Standing left at the border: conferred standing is a balance in the conferrers' ledger and not in the holder, so it does not travel with the body, as the Damascus surgeon who drives a taxi in Berlin is exactly as skilled and has lost all deference; the conversion fails by venue rather than by rate, and the local registry prices re-entry as if from zero, because it never wrote the entry it is being asked to honor.
neighbors.right: Staleness discount: an entry in the registry expires unless it is re-witnessed, so the carpenter six years out of work loses credit at a rate set by the length of the gap and not by any change in the hands; the refusal here is temporal where the border's is spatial, a document repairs one and only a fresh shift repairs the other, and the padded résumé is the fraud of inventing witnesses for the missing years.
neighbors.separating_case: A nurse still employed in Kraków applying in Manchester has current witnesses and the wrong registry; a Manchester nurse six years out of work applying in Manchester has the right registry and no recent entry. A recognition agreement between the two registries repairs the first case and does nothing for the second, and a single supervised shift repairs the second and does nothing for the first, so the two refusals have different operators even though both leave a competent nurse unconverted.

checks.boundary_case: Bribery is out: money converts into a decision, not into standing. The official confers nothing and the payer holds no balance afterward; the act is the whole product, and the fraud is the act rather than the conversion. Introducer's tab is in on exactly that contrast, since the bribed official spends nothing of his own while the introducer spends standing, and what the payer of a bribe gets cannot be presented to a third party as anyone's verdict on him.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the sequence conceals, Witnessed save to Practice given to the trusted, where deference earned by one save buys the cases that produce the next, with an entry problem for whoever has not yet saved. It shows an incompatibility, Witnessed save to Furniture's ear, where being noticed and hearing cannot be held by one body in one room. It shows a fork, Scar tariff to Cashing out, where sacrifice splits at compensation into authority or salary and cannot keep both. It shows a dependency, Notarized standing to Standing left at the border, where the border fires only if registries fail to recognize each other and no act of the holder repairs it. And it shows a passage between levels, Time as the only tender to Staleness discount, where a rule about how a person is admitted becomes a property of the registry's clock, which confers and forgets at the same fixed rate and runs one way.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a conversion, its carrier, a shape for the rate, and a place where it is called fraud, in the survivor's register rather than as advice; the strange members (an ear that works better the lower one stands, a premium paid only to those who do not ask, a purchase that erases what it buys, a registry that accepts only years) are kept as mechanisms and not softened into counsel about humility or patience.
